verdict.rationale: cfo.ai's pricing page lists "Proactive alerts & triggers" as a product feature, and the docs say Ari messages users when something moves and updates the Model when a connected file changes. That points to some built-in event-driven behavior. Nothing shows users can write their own rules (conditions plus actions); the nightly refresh is a recurring schedule, not an event trigger. Missing for 10: documentation of user-defined trigger rules, configurable conditions and actions, a list of supported event types, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
